name: deepseek-harness-desktop
description: A Windows desktop wrapper for the official DeepSeek Harness.
author: DeepSeek Harness Desktop contributors

scripts.verify: node scripts/check-version-consistency.cjs && node scripts/check-runtime-dependencies.cjs && node scripts/check-powershell-syntax.cjs
scripts.release:prepare: npm run release:clean && npm run verify
scripts.release:finalize: npm run verify && node scripts/check-packaged-dependencies.cjs --all && node scripts/generate-third-party-licenses.cjs && node scripts/generate-sbom.cjs && node scripts/generate-release-metadata.cjs
scripts.release:finalize:x64: npm run verify && node scripts/check-packaged-dependencies.cjs --expected=x64 && node scripts/generate-third-party-licenses.cjs && node scripts/generate-sbom.cjs && node scripts/generate-release-metadata.cjs --expected=x64
scripts.release:finalize:arm64: npm run verify && node scripts/check-packaged-dependencies.cjs --expected=arm64 && node scripts/generate-third-party-licenses.cjs && node scripts/generate-sbom.cjs && node scripts/generate-release-metadata.cjs --expected=arm64
scripts.pack: npm run verify && node scripts/ensure-target-runtime.cjs x64 && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --win dir --x64
scripts.pack:x64: npm run verify && node scripts/ensure-target-runtime.cjs x64 && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --win dir --x64
scripts.pack:arm64: npm run verify && node scripts/ensure-target-runtime.cjs arm64 && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --win dir --arm64
scripts.build: node scripts/ensure-target-runtime.cjs x64 && node scripts/ensure-target-runtime.cjs arm64 && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --win nsis --x64 --arm64
scripts.build:x64: npm run release:prepare && node scripts/ensure-target-runtime.cjs x64 && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --win nsis --x64 && npm run release:finalize:x64
scripts.build:arm64: npm run release:prepare && node scripts/ensure-target-runtime.cjs arm64 && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --win nsis --arm64 && npm run release:finalize:arm64
